sleep_interruption.evidence: Read-only local power-log inspection; wake times coincide with lost task records.
sleep_interruption.interpretation: Lost leases are interruption failures, not compute timeouts or negative scientific verdicts. Lost attempts have no returned CPU/RSS metrics; no retry was performed.

verification_utilization_sample.note: Sample of actual running verification processes, separate from configured capacity and terminal-attempt totals.

verification_catalogue_diagnostic.scope: Selected saved catalogues loaded sequentially in a separate diagnostic process after the benchmark terminated; no rematching or re-verification.

historical_verification_diagnostic.scope: Same selected inputs and search settings across different scientific implementations. Historical query CPU excludes catalogue load; current task CPU includes it. Separate current load timings are warm, not a subtraction control. Execution layouts and retained mapping relations differ.

source_findings.finding: verify_catalogue and query_path wrappers are AST-identical; per-family rebuilding existed historically.

Historical compilation used per-source compatible target sets, then reference restrictions and propagation before remaining bond tables. Current early rejection uses a global reachable-target union and compiles local relations before conditioning on the reference.

Current compilation constructs complete discovery choices and both constrained relaxed self-actions. Allowed-pair tables are rebuilt per compilation; downstream component caching cannot avoid this preceding work. The added two-sided coverage is required.

historical_verification_diagnostic.interpretation: Family count alone does not explain the measurements. Earlier rejection and shared preparation are concrete optimization targets; static code evidence does not apportion the measured cost. No algorithm change or new verification run was used for this comparison.

verification_runner_elapsed_scope: Maintained runner time.monotonic elapsed; distinct from UTC attempt-timestamp spans. Both original measurements are retained without treating their different clock and start/end scopes as interchangeable.

reaction_completion.definition: First successful direction for a recovered reaction; later completed negative direction for a reaction missed in both directions. Execution errors and unknown queries do not prove absence.
